To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a certification system for bitcoins can be built on the existing infrastructure of the blockchain, and that the certification can be provided by trusted authorities.

a) we present the first certification system for Bitcoin; b) the system offers an opt-in guarantee of the authenticity of the sender and recipient of the transaction, and of the amount of bitcoins involved; c) the system is compatible with the Bitcoin protocol, which is a critical requirement for the adoption of our proposal.

a) the absence of certification of bitcoins addresses creates obstacles to its adoption in e-commerce and in official transactions; b) we propose a certification system that offers: a guarantee to send/receive bitcoins only to/from certified users, and control of bitcoins addresses creation (certified users), by trusted authorities; c) our proposal may encourage the use of Bitcoin as an official currency in different scenarios that currently use fiat currencies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a certification system for the Bitcoin currency.
the design of a certification system for Bitcoins that can be integrated into the Bitcoin architecture.
the development of a certification system for bitcoins that will help Bitcoin to be adopted as an official currency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Bitcoin system is not only a peer-to-peer electronic cash system, but also a peer-to-peer certification system for the creation of certified addresses.
the Bitcoin system is a decentralized peer-to-peer payment network that is powered by its users with no central authority or middlemen.
Bitcoin is a digital currency, and that it is not a commodity, a currency, or a security.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a system to certify Bitcoin addresses.
we have designed a system that is a combination of a trusted third-party and a decentralized system.
we have proposed a novel certification system for Bitcoin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Bitcoin can be used as a payment method in e-commerce and other official scenarios if it is properly certified by trusted authorities.
Bitcoin’s architecture can be extended to support the creation of certified users.

Bitcoin is a technology that is not limited to the financial sector, and that it can be extended to other areas where a decentralized and secure system is required, e.g., for the management of sensitive data, such as medical information, or for the protection of intellectual property.
